name: GET /api/leadflow/workflows/definitions - automations and their live version
description:
Workflows grouped by KEY rather than listed as versions, because the question the screen asks is "what automations are running" and a flat version list answers "what has ever been written" — a hundred rows for six automations.

A DEFINITION WITH VERSIONS AND NO LIVE ONE IS LISTED AS UNPUBLISHED rather than omitted. That is usually somebody who ran the dry run, saw the number and stopped — which is the gate working, and worth seeing.

testCases.name: NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
